drone_count.zh_description: 用于系统运行和训练环境初始化；直接回车将沿用当前默认无人机数量。
drone_count.en_description: Used for runtime and training environment setup. Press Enter to keep the current default drone count.

simulation_visualization.zh_description: 控制 APF 基线多轮仿真、学习训练阶段和四组最终统一仿真对比是否弹出可视化窗口。
simulation_visualization.en_description: Controls whether the APF baseline simulation stage, learning-stage training, and the final four-group comparison open visualization windows.

ddpg_total_timesteps.zh_description: 用于 DDPG+APF 学习阶段；后面的时间是按默认仿真步长换算的仿真时间预估。
ddpg_total_timesteps.en_description: Used for the DDPG+APF learning stage. The time shown below is an estimated simulation duration based on the default step length.

dqn_total_timesteps.zh_description: 用于 DQN 学习阶段；后面的时间是按默认仿真步长换算的仿真时间预估。
dqn_total_timesteps.en_description: Used for the DQN learning stage. The time shown below is an estimated simulation duration based on the default step length.

dqn_resume_total_timesteps.zh_description: 用于 DQN 续训场景；后面的时间是按默认仿真步长换算的仿真时间预估。
dqn_resume_total_timesteps.en_description: Used for DQN resume scenarios. The time shown below is an estimated simulation duration based on the default step length.

hrl_total_timesteps.zh_label: 分层 DQN 训练步数
hrl_total_timesteps.zh_description: 用于分层 DQN 训练阶段；默认值取自分层 DQN 配置文件。
hrl_total_timesteps.en_description: Used for the hierarchical DQN training stage. The default comes from the hierarchical DQN config file.

apf_baseline_episodes.zh_label: APF 基线多轮仿真轮次
apf_baseline_episodes.zh_description: 用于 fixed APF / random APF 的基线多轮仿真阶段，主要生成过程对比数据。
apf_baseline_episodes.en_description: Used for the fixed APF / random APF baseline multi-episode simulation stage. This mainly generates process-comparison data.

benchmark_eval_episodes.zh_label: 四组 benchmark 每 seed 评测轮次
benchmark_eval_episodes.zh_description: 用于四组最终统一仿真对比阶段，决定每个 seed 下每组的评测回合数。
benchmark_eval_episodes.en_description: Used for the final four-group unified simulation comparison stage. This controls how many evaluation episodes each group runs under every seed.

paper_seeds.zh_description: 用于论文多 Seed 训练；输入多个 Seed 时请用英文逗号分隔。
paper_seeds.en_description: Used for paper-style multi-seed training. Separate multiple seeds with standard commas.

run_fixed.zh_title: 固定权重运行 - 快速配置
run_fixed.zh_intro: 仅配置当前入口需要的参数；直接回车将沿用默认值。
run_fixed.en_intro: Only the parameters relevant to this entry are shown here. Press Enter to keep the defaults.

run_ddpg.zh_title: DDPG 权重预测运行 - 快速配置
run_ddpg.zh_intro: 仅配置当前入口需要的参数；直接回车将沿用默认值。
run_ddpg.en_title: DDPG Weight Prediction Runtime - Quick Config
run_ddpg.en_intro: Only the parameters relevant to this entry are shown here. Press Enter to keep the defaults.

ddpg_train.en_intro: Only the training parameters relevant to this entry are shown here. Press Enter to keep the defaults.

ddpg_single_episode.zh_intro: 该入口通常用于单轮在线更新；如需调整训练步数，可在此覆盖默认值。
ddpg_single_episode.en_title: DDPG Single-Episode Crazyflie Training - Quick Config
ddpg_single_episode.en_intro: This entry is usually used for a single online update. Override the training steps here if needed.

dqn_train.zh_title: DQN 训练 - 快速配置
dqn_train.zh_intro: 仅配置当前入口需要的训练参数；直接回车将沿用默认值。
dqn_train.en_intro: Only the training parameters relevant to this entry are shown here. Press Enter to keep the defaults.

dqn_resume_train.zh_title: DQN 续训 - 快速配置
dqn_resume_train.zh_intro: 仅配置当前入口需要的训练参数；直接回车将沿用默认值。
dqn_resume_train.en_intro: Only the training parameters relevant to this entry are shown here. Press Enter to keep the defaults.

hrl_train.zh_title: 分层 DQN 训练 - 快速配置
hrl_train.zh_intro: 仅配置当前入口需要的训练参数；直接回车将沿用默认值。
hrl_train.en_intro: Only the training parameters relevant to this entry are shown here. Press Enter to keep the defaults.

four_group_benchmark.zh_title: 四组统一仿真对比阶段 - 快速配置
four_group_benchmark.zh_intro: 这里配置的是四组最终统一仿真评测的采样规模；直接回车将沿用默认值，不会改动训练阶段。
four_group_benchmark.en_title: Four-Group Unified Simulation Comparison - Quick Config
four_group_benchmark.en_intro: This config controls the sample size of the final four-group unified simulation evaluation. It does not change the training stages.

paper_ddpg_seeds.zh_title: 论文多 Seed 训练（DDPG+APF）- 快速配置
paper_ddpg_seeds.zh_intro: 这里配置的是多 Seed 训练的随机种子与训练步数；直接回车将沿用默认值。
paper_ddpg_seeds.en_intro: This config controls the seed list and training steps for paper-style multi-seed training. Press Enter to keep the defaults.

paper_dqn_seeds.zh_title: 论文多 Seed 训练（Pure DQN）- 快速配置
paper_dqn_seeds.zh_intro: 这里配置的是多 Seed 训练的随机种子与训练步数；直接回车将沿用默认值。
paper_dqn_seeds.en_title: Paper Multi-Seed Training (Pure DQN) - Quick Config
paper_dqn_seeds.en_intro: This config controls the seed list and training steps for paper-style multi-seed training. Press Enter to keep the defaults.

comparison_workflow.zh_title: 四组统一仿真对比阶段 - 快速配置
comparison_workflow.zh_intro: 这里会先配置无人机数量，再按纯 APF -> 随机 APF -> DDPG+APF -> 纯 DQN 的顺序组织实验。步数对应的是仿真时间预估，不等同于真实墙钟耗时。
comparison_workflow.en_title: Four-Group Unified Simulation Comparison - Quick Config
comparison_workflow.en_intro: This config first asks for drone count, then follows the experiment order: fixed APF -> random APF -> DDPG+APF -> pure DQN. Step-based durations are simulation-time estimates, not wall-clock runtime.

two_stage_workflow.zh_title: 虚实两阶段实验工作流 - 快速配置
two_stage_workflow.zh_intro: 这里会先配置无人机数量，再配置预训练阶段的训练步数；直接回车将沿用默认值。
two_stage_workflow.en_intro: This config first asks for drone count, then lets you override the pretraining step budget. Press Enter to keep the defaults.
